paragraphs: Chilfa bar Agra (a Tanna): Shabbat 105b. Rabbi Yehuda bar Agra: Chullin 134a.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Shabbat 105b paragraph names untitled Chilfa bar Agra in a transmission chain, and Chullin 134a names Rabbi Yehudah ben Agra. The source bar form and its Tanna qualifier remain attached to their own pointers; all in the collective heading is retained without asserting one common father or importing additional names and teachings.
